items: Exams frequently ask for the maximum time limit to hold fresh elections post-dissolution (6 months).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The normal prescribed tenure duration is 5 years.
Upon dissolution, fresh elections must strictly take place within a 6-month timeframe.
